title: Huh? What Is This
description: A Hard Mod Only For Snapshop Version
body:
Huh? What Is This, also named as (The Hard) 
### At the Beginning
By listening to game events to modify game content, the aim is to make the game extremely difficult to play. The mods are all malicious content. Also it will only update For SnapShot,So it might be a good idea to give it a try

### Why should I do it
The mod was inspired by a video I watched from a blogger before. I decided to write a weakened version for me and my friends to play online together. I found that the snapshot version might have some special mods, so I released it.

### Content For Mod
1.Revised naturally-spawned items for Zombies, Skeletons, their variants and other mobs.
2.Added block-breaking effects.
3.Adjusted spawn settings of specific mobs.
4.Revamped aquatic mobs and water mechanics.
5.Added special weather & event mechanics.
6.Implemented item-item interaction mechanics.
7.Added Nether entry logic.

### At Last
The snapshot version was adopted to take the opportunity to experience the new content. Because this module exists in the snapshot version, some strange bugs will occur. If you find it, please submit an Issue to my GitHub. I will update it in the next snapshot version.
